research_question: When does continued learning lose previously acquired success, and can information available on the current path distinguish useful continuation from harmful continuation? Test switching only after separating this from stopping.

hypotheses.H_path: A realized method ordering generalizes across evaluation cases more reliably than across continuation paths.
hypotheses.H_loss: Net continuation losses include losses of parent-success cases; acquisition and retention differ by task and path.
hypotheses.H_early: A specified prefix-only log signal provides information about stop-versus-continue value beyond constant actions and current training success.
hypotheses.H_action: From the same 8k learned state, stop/continue and optionally switch have reproducible conditional differences across fresh future randomness. Risk prediction alone does not imply switch benefit.

A1.within: Select using a continuation's selection half, score the same continuation's other half.
A1.across: Select using the other continuation's selection half, score the target continuation's other half, exactly matching v45.
controls: fixed method selected on the same selection half of both repeats in the other four parents
A1.aggregation: Two repeat directions x two case-half directions, average four scores per parent, then five equally weighted parents.
A1.sensitivity: Remove an entire parent and refit the fixed comparator; do not search for a favorable partition.
A1.pairwise_secondary: All three method pairs under the same splits; report every pair, no winner picked after viewing results.

A2.unit: evaluation case within parent x task
A2.pairing: The same resampled case indices apply to parent policy and all three methods and both continuations; draw separately across task strata and parents.
A2.contrasts: For each of 5 parents and 3 method pairs, d4201, d4202, and d4202-d4201: 45 contrasts in one prespecified family.
A2.intervals: Report marginal percentile 95% intervals and simultaneous max-standardized-deviation 95% intervals over the 45 contrasts. SE is the bootstrap SD; center bootstrap contrasts on observed contrasts.
A2.zero_SE: Mark a degenerate empirical interval; do not use it as affirmative evidence of population certainty or to pass a progression screen.
A2.strong_reversal_screen: Both observed repeat differences have opposite signs and magnitude >=2pp; both simultaneous intervals exclude zero with those signs.
A2.scope: Conditional on these fitted policies and the sampled evaluation bank; not a decomposition of total training variance or evidence from additional training seeds.

A3.net_identity: Per-task delta_pp = 100 * (gains-losses)/100; macro is the mean of four task deltas.
A3.zero_denominator: Conditional acquisition/retention ratios are NA if no parent failures/successes; unconditional rates still use all 100 cases.

time_windows.pretraining: fixed 20k bins for all five parents
time_windows.branches: fixed 4k bins from 0 to 40k for all thirty branches
time_windows.decision_prefix: only 0-4k and 4-8k for candidate decision inputs

available_metrics: episode any-success and full-500-step training return by task
A3.interpretation: Alpha is an entropy regularization weight, not measured policy entropy. Training episodes are not checkpoint outcome evaluation. Later-than-8k metrics are explanatory outcomes, never decision features.

A_existing_data.A_to_B_screen: Complete all A analyses regardless of direction. B requires a written prefix-only hypothesis and acquisition/loss or case-stable path evidence involving at least two parents; a final spike only in 41013 is insufficient. This is a development-investment judgment, not a significance test.
A_existing_data.A_to_optional_switch_screen: Within-repeat gains are >=1pp versus both controls and remain positive under full parent-removal refits; at least one same-pair reversal outside 41013 passes the A2 conditional simultaneous-interval screen. Necessary, not sufficient, for the later switch option.

candidate_log_rule.score: z = log((median e over 4-8k + 1e-6)/(median e over 0-4k + 1e-6)), e=(critic_0_abs_td_error+critic_1_abs_td_error)/2
candidate_log_rule.source: Logged snapshots every 250 steps; no future outcomes or O100 inputs.
candidate_log_rule.direction: stop if z is strictly greater than threshold
candidate_log_rule.invalid_input: Flag missing input, use the prespecified always-continue fallback in policy scoring; retain the state and report fallback counts. An integrity failure halts execution.
candidate_log_rule.fit: Maximize mean selected outcome with two states averaged within each fitting parent, then equal parent weights.
candidate_log_rule.tie: Fewer stop decisions, then constant rule, then always-continue first and largest numerical threshold first.
candidate_log_rule.outer_validation: Leave one parent out: fit four parents/eight states; score both states of held-out parent. Remove each parent fully and refit again for sensitivity.

simple_information_control.fit_and_folds: same parent splits and tie priorities

candidate_log_rule.secondary_logs: Alpha changes, reward, and replay counts remain descriptive. Do not substitute a favorable score/direction after seeing B results without a new version and a separate later test.
candidate_log_rule.scope: Development rule selected after seeing stage-1 findings. Success does not establish a mechanism or independent parent generalization.

B_checkpoint_evaluation.bank: Reuse each parent's frozen outcome cases for paired 8k-vs-40k development analysis; no model or RNG mutation, no replay insertion.
B_checkpoint_evaluation.target: g32 = outcome at existing dose625 40k minus outcome at dose625 8k, by parent and origin repeat. Also decompose total parent-to-40k change into parent-to-8k and 8k-to-40k changes.
B_checkpoint_evaluation.policy_information: 8k O100 is only a research label/baseline, never a free input to the candidate rule.
controls: always stop and retain the 8k policy
retain the original 200k parent without starting additional learning
B_checkpoint_evaluation.B_to_C_keep_screen: At least one parent has g32>=2pp in both origin repeats and another has g32<=-2pp in both; primary log rule LOPO gain >=1pp versus both stop-8k and continue-40k, and >=0 versus both the simple-information control and original-parent retention; full parent-removal refits retain positive gains versus stop-8k and continue-40k. If only the simple-information control succeeds, record it and formulate a new prospectively frozen proposal; do not silently replace the primary rule.
B_checkpoint_evaluation.nonpass: Do not launch new continuation branches. Report constant-action sufficiency, weak signal, or unresolved evidence separately.
B_checkpoint_evaluation.uncertainty: Parent cluster descriptive intervals and task-stratified paired-case intervals are distinct; no independent confirmation claim.

C_fresh_future_replication.selection_of_states: All five parents' dose625 8k states, fixed by label rather than observed performance; no removal of 41013.
C_fresh_future_replication.future_seed_namespace: r46-future; derive from original seed, origin label 4201 and future label; collision audit and pinned manifests required before execution
C_fresh_future_replication.operational_budget: 8k prefix +32k continuation =40k cap. Stop uses 8k and leaves the rest unused. Log processing compute and storage costs are measured separately.

C_switch_optional.condition: A switch screen and B keep screen both pass; freeze inclusion before any C future outcome is seen

C_fresh_future_replication.stop_evaluation: Reuse B's five selected 8k policy outcomes. Repeated stop scores across future labels are the same policy, not independent stop replications.
C_fresh_future_replication.common_state: Restore identical actor/critics/targets/entropy/optimizer/replay/counters/collector state. For each future label create a paired future RNG state; use that same state for keep and switch. Different future labels deliberately vary future randomness.
C_fresh_future_replication.do_not_call_legacy_start_branch: It zeros task_visits and creates a new schedule. A dedicated future fork must preserve learned state, cumulative counters, task-visit counts, inherited block position and phase for keep; only declared future random streams and switch schedule are allowed to change.
C_fresh_future_replication.phase_rule: Keep preserves the current BP schedule phase and consumed prefix. Switch starts an alternate BP phase. Never rebalance or reshuffle a prefix to fit the horizon.
C_fresh_future_replication.checkpoint_recovery: Fresh immutable outputs; full-state checkpoints no farther than 8k apart, include suffix 28k and 32k. Saving 28k is not an extra evaluation.
C_fresh_future_replication.commitment: Freeze B-fitted score/rule and record each state's stop/continue decision and hashes before either future is trained or any C outcome is inspected.
C_fresh_future_replication.replication_target: Agreement and size of stop/keep/switch contrasts across two fresh futures of the same 8k learned state, then average within parent.
C_fresh_future_replication.comparison_rules: A frozen stop/continue rule must beat both always-stop-8k and always-keep-40k. Also compare original-parent retention; beating only already-damaged 8k policies is not sufficient for overall additional-learning benefit. A later switch rule additionally needs always-switch and stop controls; do not claim an adaptive switch policy from risk prediction alone.
C_fresh_future_replication.future_parent_screen: Frozen primary rule mean gain >=1pp against stop-8k, keep-40k and original-parent retention, with positive full parent-removal means; nonconstant choices and both conditional action preferences (>=2pp) repeat across the two futures in different parents. If switching was included, the same >=1pp and positive parent-removal requirements also apply against fixed switch. Beating stop/keep alone does not establish superiority over that fixed alternative. Report uncertainty and do not weaken thresholds after observing results.
C_fresh_future_replication.scope: Known parents/states and previously used evaluation bank. New future outcomes test conditional path replication, not independent generalization to new parents.

budget_ladder.exclusions: Technical checks, retries, and any new-parent confirmation are separate. No new pretraining in A/B/C. These are conditional budget ceilings, not a reservation.

requirements: fresh parents not used for feature or rule development
if switching, fixed no-diagnostic switch and all constant-action controls
parent-level uncertainty and a frozen practical effect target
actual logging/compute and any diagnostic environment costs
later_independent_confirmation.sample_size: Freeze from conditional replication variability and desired precision, with sensitivity to uncertainty in the variance estimate; no automatic seed expansion.
later_independent_confirmation.if_4k_diagnosis_is_added: Use actual paid 4k diagnosis and +28k futures (total learned 36k), restore the full v43 five-arm cost comparison and add stop if it is an allowed action. Do not reuse +32k labels as +28k targets or give O100 as free online information.

publication_limits: A analyses are not yet executed by this design
No adaptive value inferred from hindsight maxima
No entropy interpretation from alpha alone
No factor validated by technical check counts
No new study is run or scheduled by writing this protocol
